name: Wix
thesis: Two-engine model — (1) Base44 ARR scales rapidly post-acquisition as the AI-first builder, while (2) the core Creative Subs business holds single-digit-but-positive growth. FCF margin compression in 2026 is acceptable as long as Base44 ARR keeps stair-stepping at milestone disclosures and core stays positive.
key_driver: Base44 ARR growth (milestone-disclosed) + Creative Subs holding positive

tier_1_kpis.name: Base44 ARR (milestone disclosure)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: >9 months without a milestone update (silence = stalling), OR any disclosed ARR number that implies <100% YoY growth from prior milestone

tier_1_kpis.name: Creative Subscriptions Revenue Growth (CC)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Turns negative, OR <5% for 2 consecutive Qs (single-digit positive is acceptable)

nuance.bear_case: AI builders (Bolt, Lovable, and Base44 competitors) commoditize SMB site creation. Wix downgraded by analysts in Mar 2026 on this risk.
nuance.adversarial_take: Wix owns Base44, so the AI-first builder is additive to their funnel rather than cannibalistic — but if Base44 ARR ever stalls between milestones, the bull case collapses because core Creative Subs alone doesn't justify the multiple at single-digit growth.
nuance.stress_test: Two consecutive Qs of Creative Subs <5% growth + a Base44 milestone gap >9 months would force a thesis re-evaluation.

thesis_breakers_qualitative: Base44 ARR growth decelerates below 100% YoY (vs. milestone trajectory)
FCF margin compression extends into 2027 without Base44 monetization story progressing

break_rules.narrative: Revenue declining YoY for 2 consecutive quarters — outright top-line contraction.
FCF margin below 5% for 2 consecutive Qs — cash conversion broken. (Universal floor; per-ticker rules below are stricter.)
Operating cash flow declining >10% YoY for 2 consecutive Qs.

business_model_rules.narrative: Revenue YoY < 10% for 2Q — durable creator-tooling growth thesis breaks; consumer SaaS floor.
FCF margin < 18% for 2Q — WIX's structural floor is ~20%; the FCF-compounder thesis depends on this holding.
Studio ARR YoY < 30% — Studio is the agency-tier growth lever; sub-30 means the upmarket expansion stalls.
Partners (agency / pro creator) revenue share < 30% for 2Q — the high-AOV monetization mix-shift thesis reverses.
